Class ServerSocket

java.lang.Object
it.polimi.ingsw.network.server.socket.ServerSocket
public class ServerSocket extends Object
TCP socket listener that accepts incoming client connections.

Binds to the configured port and, for each accepted connection, creates a ClientHandlerSocket, assigns it a fresh ClientMessageVisitorImpl, and submits it to a fixed thread pool for concurrent execution.

The thread pool is capped at 1000 threads to bound resource usage while still supporting a large number of simultaneous connections.

  • Method Details

    • start

      public void start()
      Starts the acceptance loop.

      Opens a ServerSocket on port and enters an infinite loop that blocks on accept(). For each new connection a ClientHandlerSocket is created, its visitor is set, and it is submitted to the thread pool.

      If the server socket fails to bind or encounters a fatal I/O error, the error is logged to stderr and the method returns.
